question: Should this Workboard-only refactor retain the global TypeScript LOC baseline increases for unrelated files, or should those deltas be removed or separated before merge?
rationale: The split itself is well proven, but accepting unrelated guard-baseline increases is a repository-maintenance choice that cannot be justified solely by the Workboard change.

options.title: Rebase and isolate Workboard changes
options.body: Rebase onto current main and remove global LOC-baseline deltas that are not caused by this PR's Workboard files, separating any still-needed baseline refresh.

options.title: Accept the combined baseline refresh
options.body: Land the unrelated LOC allowances with this PR only after confirming each value reflects current-main file size and does not mask new debt.

recommendation.title: Rebase and isolate Workboard changes
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main and remove global LOC-baseline deltas that are not caused by this PR's Workboard files, separating any still-needed baseline refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: They sponsored the tracked refactor and authored both the split and the final baseline-refresh commit.
